turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Kya hua beta ko?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Doctor ji, isko kal raat se bukhar hai, 102 tak gaya tha. Khana bhi nahi kha raha.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Ulti ya dast?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Ulti ek baar hui thi, dast nahi.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Theek hai. Viral fever hai. Paracetamol syrup 5 ml, 1-1-1, teen din. Aur ORS dete rahiye.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Pichli baar Glycomet 500 diya tha, le rahe ho?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Haan doctor sahab, roz le raha hoon. Par abhi bhi thakaan rehti hai.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Fasting 174 aaya hai. Dose badha dete hain. Glycomet 1000 mg, 1-0-1, khane ke baad, ek mahine. Mithai band.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: मैडम, दो दिन से पेशाब में जलन है।

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: बुखार है?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: नहीं, बुखार नहीं है। पेट के नीचे थोड़ा दर्द है।

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Urine infection लग रहा है। Nitrofurantoin 100 mg दिन में दो बार पांच दिन के लिए। पानी ज़्यादा पीजिए।

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Batao kya problem hai.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Khana khane ke baad seene mein jalan hoti hai, khatti dakar aati hai. Ek mahine se.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Chest pain hota hai chalne pe?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nahi.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Gastritis hai. Pantoprazole 40 mg subah khali pet, 14 din. Chai aur masala kam.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Any drug allergies?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Haan, amoxicillin se pura body pe rash aa gaya tha. Penicillin allergy likha hai file mein.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Achha. Gala dikhaiye. Tonsils swollen hain, pus bhi hai. Kab se?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Chaar din se, aur bukhar bhi.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Pharyngitis hai. Penicillin nahi de sakte, toh Azithromycin 500 mg OD, 3 din. Paracetamol SOS.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Sir, BP ki goli khatam ho gayi thi, das din se nahi li.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Kaunsi goli? Telma 40?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Haan wahi.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: BP 164 by 102 hai, isliye sar dard ho raha hoga. Telma 40 roz subah, band mat karna. Ek mahine ki de raha hoon.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have cold and cough since three days, doctor. Throat also paining.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Fever?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No fever.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: It is a viral infection, antibiotic ki zaroorat nahi hai. Cetirizine 10 mg at night for five days, steam lijiye.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Kitni baar loose motion hua?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Subah se chhe saat baar. Pet mein marod bhi hai.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Khoon aaya? Bukhar?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Na khoon, na bukhar.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Pet ka infection hai. Electral ka packet ek litre paani mein. Ondem 4 mg zarurat pade toh. Kal tak theek na ho toh aana.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Doctor saab, dama ki purani bimari hai. Kal se phir saans phool rahi hai.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Pump le rahe ho?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Asthalin ka pump khatam ho gaya.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Oxygen 93 hai. Asthalin inhaler, do puff, jab saans phoole tab. Aur Montair 10 raat ko, do hafte. Teen din baad dikhana.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: आठ दिन से बुखार? Widal करवाया?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: हाँ जी, report positive आई है। भूख बिल्कुल नहीं लगती।

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Typhoid है। Azithromycin 500 mg रोज़ एक बार, सात दिन। Crocin 650 बुखार हो तब। उबला पानी पीना।

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Aadhe sir mein dard hota hai, hafte mein do teen baar. Roshni se zyada hota hai, ji bhi machlata hai.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Aankhon ke aage dhundhla ya chakkar?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Nahi.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Migraine hai. Dard shuru ho toh Brufen 400, saath mein Domstal 10. Neend poori lo.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Paanch din se tez bukhar, aankhon ke peeche dard, haath pairon mein dard.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Mosquito wala area hai? Daane?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Haan, kal se pair pe laal daane.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Dengue ka shak hai. NS1 aur platelet count. Sirf Dolo 650, 1-1-1. Painkiller jaise Voveran nahi lena. Kal report ke saath aana.
